title: Oramics
description: A loop of clear 35mm film runs slowly past a reader, the way Daphne Oram's machine read shapes drawn on film. Draw on the strip and the ink plays as it crosses the line of light: its height is the pitch, its thickness is how loud. Slow strokes lay down heavy ink and sing, quick ones whisper, and the loop brings every drawing back around.
intent: Image is sound, after Daphne Oram's Oramics machine (https://www.daphneoram.org/?p=4469), where shapes drawn on strips of clear 35mm film set pitch and volume as they passed photocells, and Norman McLaren's Synchromy: what you see is what you hear.
